errors.evidence: The description states that the sector for 'Областен град' is blue ('син сектор'), but the chart and legend clearly show it is red.

errors.text_span: който представлява 9,9% от общия брой отговори
errors.evidence: The description states that the orange sector ('Друг град') represents 9.9%, but this value is not present on the chart. The two visible percentages (81.8% and 9.1%) sum to 90.9%, leaving 9.1% for the remaining two sectors, so 9.9% is impossible.

The description states that the green sector ('Село') represents 1.2%. This value is not shown on the chart. The percentages provided in the description (81.8%, 9.1%, 9.9%, 1.2%) sum to 102%, which is incorrect.

errors.text_span: етикети с проценти, вписани директно в всеки съответен сектор
errors.evidence: The description claims that percentage labels are written inside 'every respective sector'. However, only two of the four sectors (the blue and red ones) have percentage labels. The orange and green sectors do not.
